integrity: The proof uses an elementary configuration identity and existing variance Itô formula and squared-Bessel transition theory. No claim of independent verification or exhaustive bibliographic priority is made. Standalone finite checks are supplementary to the mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: The pointwise closure classification concerns \(N\ge2\), spatial dimension \(d\ge1\), and \(p\ge0\). The exact inverse-gamma law requires \(d=1\), \(N=3\), \(p=2\), \(q=1\), initially positive variance, \(\kappa>0\), and \(\rho\in[0,1)\). General nonlinear shape-dependent systems, exact-consensus initial data, and almost-sure convergence of \(tS_t\) are not covered.
title: Unique nonlinear scalar closure for variance-feedback interacting diffusions and its inverse-gamma law
